panelFiles.prompt:
Create one artwork-only 5x7 portrait Front Cover panel for a premium greeting card.
This is an artwork layer, not a finished panel.
Panel Type: Front Cover
Size: 5x7 portrait
Output: Flat 2D print artwork
Style: Premium greeting card
Palette: Deep charcoal, warm gold, ivory accents
Motif: Elegant radial sunburst
Mood: Respectful, warm, sophisticated
Panel Role: primary typography measurement panel
Headline length: 4 words.
Body length: 1 short sentence.
Reserve visual hierarchy accordingly with a large quiet headline area and a smaller readable body area.
Text-safe field requirement: keep the central text-safe field mostly plain, low-contrast, and unornamented.
Do not place sunburst rays, starbursts, borders, ornaments, bright marks, fake glyphs, or high-contrast details inside the text-safe field.
Place a broad plain deep-charcoal text-safe field in the central 55% of the panel. Keep the headline and body field free of rays, ornaments, bright marks, fake glyphs, and high-contrast details. Put the sunburst as a restrained partial halo outside that central field, mostly near the upper and lower margins.

Panel-specific composition: deep charcoal field, warm gold radial sunburst, ivory accent details, generous margins, front-cover hierarchy.

Use the same deep charcoal, warm gold, ivory-accent sunburst card system across the folded card.
Keep generous safe margins and a clear, uncluttered type-safe area.
Do not render any words, letters, numbers, handwriting, calligraphy, labels, captions, logos, or fake decorative text.
No mockups, no folded card rendering, no physical paper texture, no stock-photo appearance.
